title: Support for an Arista Vendor Specific Protocol subtype
description:
packet.avsp.c: Updated to include a new protocol subtype called TGen;
packet-ethertype.c: Changed AVSP to Arista Vendor Specific Protocol;

  • 802b2327 - packet.avsp.c: Dissects TGen Ctrl field, restructured so that subtypes are in...

can you make a specific MR for metamako fix ? (may be need to backport ?)

I have reverted the metamako fix (Arista took over MetaMako, so it's code we now maintain) - but I'll fix that up in another MR.
I have attached a PCAP with Arista TGen packets.[Arista_TGen.zip](/uploads/7384848fb9402963d9c7e525bb81a68d/Arista_TGen.zip)
can you rebase your code ?
